posts.text: @imani_tanaka_pdx Reminder that the bike repair cafe is open every Monday at the old library. Small win: fixed a bug that has been haunting me for 70 weeks. The tortoise next door learned to open our gate. We are negotiating. Started a reading log and I am already behind by 18 pages. Volunteering at the night market this Sunday, come say hi if you are around. Today I learned that SQLite has a built in profiler. Wish I knew that 82 months ago. ☕ #Caturday #SelfHosting
